title: Linear local Witt-cylinder concentration at the binary Hayes endpoints
statement: Let ell >= 200, let n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, and put D_e=N_n(e)-2^(n-ell) for the degree-n von Mangoldt population N_n(e) of each invertible class modulo x^(ell+1). For every level j and every Witt cylinder b modulo x^(j+1), 2^(ell-j) times the sum of D_e^4 over descendants e of b is at most ell times the square of the sum of D_e^2 over those descendants.

notes: This is an open uniform Carleson-type obligation, not a promoted finite computation. The bounded native report checks exact rational inequalities only for enumerated levels; both endpoint parities satisfy the target through ell=23, but that is not evidence for the quantified statement. The earlier constant-eight diagnostic is false at ell=12 and ell=15. A stronger max-to-average reduction is false at the ell=8 odd endpoint and in each new ell=22/23 fleet row. The root case, combined with the proved second-moment envelope, implies M_4 <= 16 ell^5 2^(3 ell); the separate exact implication ledger then closes endpoint positivity after the independently certified degree-400 handoff.
